'''2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC''' (also '''Batmouse's 10th Annual GEMPC''') was the Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP in the [[Open]] format. Play ran May–July 2026. The Players Committee results page is dated 4 July 2026 (updated 16 July 2026).<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/</ref>

[[Patrick Johnson]] (also Pat Johnson / Pmj) won the Finals over [[Drew Lichtenstein]]. [[Sam Tashima]] finished third; [[Jarad Konsker]] fourth.<ref name="pc" /><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge bracket 18vokbxb]</ref> Johnson also finished #17 at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].

The PC article listed the Round of 64 '''by seed''', not by finish. Finish numbers below are reconstructed from the Challonge '''single-elimination''' bracket, working backwards from Johnson as Finals winner. Within the same round of elimination, players are ordered by original seed (lower seed number first). Challonge still showed the Finals match as open (progress 98%) when captured; Johnson is recorded as champion from the PC Top 8 list, the championship YouTube matches, and that reconstruction.<ref name="challonge" /><ref name="pc" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Platform:''' SWCCG GEMP
* '''Structure:''' Seeded '''single elimination''' (Challonge; 68 participants including a four-match play-in into a Round of 64)
* '''Bracket:''' [https://challonge.com/18vokbxb challonge.com/18vokbxb]
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1595 10th Annual GEMPC Forum]
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86845 forum t=86845] (inner zip <code>2026 Gempc.zip</code> / Top 8 <code>2026 Gempc Top 8.zip</code>)
* '''Video:''' [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQSFYZX0M9YQOr2wLL2JQMshuie6hLniG YouTube playlist]

== Missing from the GEMP zip / PC list ==

Recorded here so the field is not silently shortened:

* '''No GEMP import file''' in <code>2026 Gempc.zip</code>: [[Matt Wadden]] (Challonge seed 29, finished #28). PC listed Court / Luke Saga for him with no attached list.
* '''Play-in (Round 1) on Challonge, not on the PC published R64 and not in the zip:''' Vivik Kembaiyan (seed 62), Sean Hensley (65), Norman Hall (66), Joe Hosking (68). Adam Bott (seed 63) won a play-in then lost Round of 64; no zip file.
* '''On Challonge Round of 64, not in the PC seed list:''' [[Alex Prodoehl]] (seed 51, finished #51). He also played the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (#12).
* '''Name:''' [[Charles Hickey]] (GEMP '''teacher'''). Challonge listed him as Charless Hickey; the Retro GEMPC table used Charlie. Same player.
* '''Starting interrupt, not an Objective:''' [[Amar Banger]] and [[Robbie Hendon]] Light lists have [[Let The Wookiee Win (V)]] (PC labeled LTWW(V)). Banger's starting location is inferred as [[Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers]] (exactly two [Light]; Kashyyyk is deployed by the interrupt). Hendon's start is [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]] (that site deploys only as a starting location, so it would otherwise be unplayable).
* Challonge scores are often 0–0 (result entered without game count). Where YouTube posted a score, it is not copied here unless it was on the bracket.
